The TraxProbe firmware SDK uses a split license. The SPDX-License-Identifier
line at the top of each source file decides which license applies to it.

  Core engine (inc/, src/, config/, debug/, os/common/)
    SPDX: LicenseRef-TraxProbe-Commercial
    License: TraxProbe Commercial License — see LICENSE-COMMERCIAL.txt

  Porting layer (hw_port/, os/FreeRTOS/, os/BareMetal/, and the reference
  transport backends)
    SPDX: Apache-2.0
    License: Apache License, Version 2.0 — see LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt

  SEGGER RTT (transports/RTT/SEGGER_RTT.*, SEGGER_RTT_Conf.h)
    License: SEGGER's license, as stated in those files

See LICENSE.md for details and NOTICE for attributions.

The Traxcope desktop application is licensed separately under its End User
License Agreement (licenses/EULA.txt in the Traxcope installation).
